items.title: Old Phuket Town
items.subtitle: Wijk in Phuket, Thailand
items.description: Het levendige Phuket Old Town staat bekend om zijn vrolijk gekleurde Sino-Portugese herenhuizen van een eeuw oud. Aan Soi Rommanee staat een rij bijzonder goed geconserveerde exemplaren. Thalang Road is de hoofdstraat, met winkels die ambachtelijk ijs en batikstoffen verkopen. Ook vindt er een zondagse markt plaats met souvenirs en streetfood als gebakken banaan. Het Thai Hua-museum heeft tentoonstellingen over de Chinese immigrantencultuur en in de Jui Tui-tempel zijn kleurrijke beelden van Chinese goden te zien. ― Google

items.markdown:
![The Rich History of Phuket Old Town - Pullman Phuket Panwa](https://api.dataforseo.com/cdn/i/07311136-1672-0139-0000-d52773fbcadc:16)
Phuket Old Town is `the historic heart of Phuket City in southern Thailand` , famous for its vibrant Sino-Portuguese architecture, colorful colonial shophouses, and rich tin-mining history.[](https://northabroad.com/phuket-old-town-guide/) [[1]](https://northabroad.com/phuket-old-town-guide/)[[2]](https://www.global-gallivanting.com/old-phuket-town-guide/)[[3]](https://www.tripadvisor.com/Attraction_Review-g2315818-d5995325-Reviews-Old_Phuket_Town-Talat_Yai_Phuket_Town_Phuket.html)

Key Streets and Sights

- **Thalang Road** : The main cultural artery lined with bright, historic shophouses, fabric shops, and local eateries.
- **Soi Romanee** : A narrow, incredibly photogenic alley with pastel-colored Sino-Portuguese buildings and cafes.
- **Phang Nga Road & Dibuk Road** : Home to classic mansions, old printing shops, and The Memory at On On Hotel (famous from the film *The Beach*).[](https://www.midnightblueelephant.com/phuket-old-town-thailand/) [[1]](https://www.midnightblueelephant.com/phuket-old-town-thailand/)[[2]](https://www.phuket101.net/phuket-town-guide/)[[3]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Phuket_Old_Town)[[4]](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=_LLpLYBKZR4&t=4)[[5]](https://www.333travel.nl/thailand/tour/phuket-old-town)

Food and Markets

- **Sunday Walking Street Market (Lard Yai)** : Held weekly on Thalang Road from 4:00 PM to 10:00 PM, featuring local street food, crafts, and music.
- **Local Cuisine** : Famous for Peranakan dishes like Hokkien mee noodles, local coffee shops, and Michelin-guide spots.
- **Thai Hua Museum** : A former Chinese-language school sharing the heritage of Chinese immigrants.[](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=2oRxTU1kNjw&t=16) [[1]](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=2oRxTU1kNjw&t=16)[[2]](https://www.jamiesphuketblog.com/2019/07/10-things-to-do-in-phuket-town.html)[[3]](https://www.thethaipass.com/attractions/phuket-old-town)
